prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1145; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with reported headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism and force of the crash are consistent with the injury described, and the symptom pattern fits a concussion. Over the course of twelve visits, care followed a typical progression, beginning with symptom monitoring, graded return to activity, and vestibular and cognitive support, and tapered as symptoms steadily resolved. Imaging and neurological examination findings clearly confirm the diagnosis. The patient reports a small strain to the same region several years ago, which healed completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Prognosis is good with continued gradual return to normal activities and follow-up as needed.
